title: CRASH-089: html entity decode uni 338 402 table undersized vs endchar oob (global-buffer-overflow)
live_proof: measured, not asserted: our native ASan build of the pinned 5.0.0 tarball (p12, gcc 15.2.0, libasan from gcc 15, 2026-10-27) reports ASAN:global-buffer-overflow at ext/standard/html.c:900 in php_unescape_html_entities when trigger.php runs; the corpus records the fix as php-src bd2e99ee50ed, which postdates the release, and names the defect at ext/standard/html.c:108 (undersized literal) + ext/standard/html.c:398 (declared 338..402) ; OOB read executed at ext/standard/html.c:900
fidelity: the corpus's own trigger script, run through the real interpreter (PHP's cli SAPI, ext/standard only, the port's 145 translation units) rather than reduced to a C model. What it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it. The pristine build completes it natively, so an arm that completes it saw nothing.
